source: Worked out from this exchange: 1,000 USDC for 800 AERO.
The USDC is valued at Chainlink's USDC/USD price at this block.
scope: Checking the block shows that the data Amp stored matches the block's header, and that one of Base's nodes reports the same block. It doesn't show that the header is on Base's real chain, or that the dataset's calculations ran correctly. A dataset's fingerprint only identifies its recipe.
It covers the amounts exchanged. It doesn't cover Chainlink's price, used to value them, because block headers don't record calls to a contract.
